question: D8 amended at build: the clean rehearsal record hashes the ticket AFTER its rehearsal pointer is written (point-then-hash), not before — do you accept that as the protocol, or should the hash cover the ticket with the pointer field stripped?
why_it_blocks: D8 said the clean record hashes the ticket; but writing the rehearsal pointer INTO the ticket changes its bytes, so hash-then-point leaves every clean record stale by construction. Built as point-then-hash (the pointer lands first, the record hashes the bytes with the pointer in them) — the sieve reads green on that today. If you want the hash to cover the pre-pointer bytes instead, the sieve needs to strip the field before hashing; a one-line change, but it is your protocol to name.
